integrity: Proof includes exact hypergeometric degree identity, four-corner mixed-factorial Poisson convergence, spatial localization and continuous mapping to the induced graph. Finite checker is independent corroboration of identities, not an asymptotic certificate.
scientific_limitations: Uniform permutation, fixed threshold and fixed ranks only. No error rate; no nonuniform permuton or growing threshold claim. Priority remains subject to independent literature review.
title: Four-corner Poisson geometry and induced subgraphs of extremal permutation-graph degrees
